# Reference genome list
```{r}
reference_genomes <- readRDS("./data/public_genomes/reference_genome_detection/best_MERLIN_NCBI_reference_genome_choices.RDS") 
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/MERLIN_cohort_metadata_final.RDS") %>% subset(qc_pass==T & WGS_escre==T)
```

# Create file lists
```{r}
rfmt_script <- readLines("./scripts/public_genomes/SNPKIT_variant_calling/snpkit_model_scripts/snpkit_reformat_directories_model.sh")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(reference_genomes))){
  analysis_group <- reference_genomes$analysis_group[[i]]
  new_script <- rfmt_script
  new_script <- gsub("analysis_group",analysis_group,new_script)
  writeLines(text = new_script,con = paste0("./scripts/public_genomes/SNPKIT_variant_calling/snpkit_reformat_directories//snpkit_reformat_directories_MERLIN_",analysis_group,".sh"))
}
```
